meta.name: Fund the new v1claim-deployer wallet with gas ETH only

transactions._comment: Sends 0.001 ETH (plain transfer) to a BRAND NEW keystore ('v1claim-deployer', created this session specifically for this one deploy -- never the old compromised deployer). Dry-run estimated the actual deploy cost at ~0.0000253 ETH, so this is ~40x margin, still negligible on this L2. This wallet is gas-only: it deploys BallastV1Claim (one transaction, nonce 0) and does nothing else ever again.
